configurations.name: docs
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd apps/docs && npx docusaurus start --port 3004

configurations.name: devtool
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd apps/devtool && pnpm exec vite --port 3005 --strictPort

configurations.name: claude-code-style-agent
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.13.0 > /dev/null && cd labs/claude-code-style && trap 'kill 0' EXIT && pnpm exec vite build && (pnpm exec vite build --watch > /dev/null 2>&1 &) && cd ../.. && CLAUDE_CODE_STYLE_DATA=.fsdev/claude-code-style-agent pnpm exec tsx packages/cli/bin/fsdev.ts dev --config labs/claude-code-style/fsdev.config.mts --app @flow-state-dev/claude-code-style --port 3240 --no-open --watch

configurations.name: teammates
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.13.0 > /dev/null && cd labs/teammates && pnpm exec vite build && pnpm exec tsx ../../packages/cli/bin/fsdev.ts dev --app @flow-state-dev/teammates --port 3250 --no-open

configurations.name: knowledge-hub
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.13.0 > /dev/null && cd labs/knowledge-hub && FSDEV_DEBUG_ENDPOINTS=1 KH_MCP_SECRET=test pnpm exec tsx ../../packages/cli/bin/fsdev.ts dev --port 3260 --no-open
